statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-26933 affects Packetbeat protocol parser components. The image builds only the x-pack/filebeat command; it does not build or ship Packetbeat, and the affected Packetbeat parser code is not compiled into the Filebeat binary. Scout reports the vulnerability against the repository-wide elastic/beats module PURL.

CVE-2026-26931 affects Metricbeat's Prometheus remote_write handler. The image builds only the x-pack/filebeat command; it does not build or ship Metricbeat, and the affected Metricbeat handler is not compiled into the Filebeat binary. Scout reports the vulnerability against the repository-wide elastic/beats module PURL.

CVE-2025-68383 affects the Filebeat Syslog parser and Libbeat Dissect processor in Beats 8.0.0 through 8.19.8, 9.0.0 through 9.1.8, and 9.2.0 through 9.2.2. Elastic fixed the vulnerability in 8.19.9, 9.1.9, and 9.2.3. The listed Filebeat versions 9.5.0 and 9.5.1 contain the upstream fix; Scout reports them because its advisory applies an unfixed broad range to the elastic/beats module PURLs.
